DEVIATION FROM THE CARD mock path: mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the task cannot be opened here (Isaac Sim 4.5, Isaac Lab 2.0.0, a task cfg and the manually unzipped USD assets, README.md:3-5 and :74-78); the fake is the package's own pure Python interface stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream simulator, and the sim path (gymnasium.make of the registered task) was not run. The fake models the contract, not the physics: one environment with the default 8-value action (six joint-position targets and two wheel-velocity targets) and a 28-value stack_policy observation; the upstream spaces are batched over 4096 environments and its observation_space is a Dict of four groups, and the fake's non-action observations and reward are fixed placeholders (marked # placeholder). It truncates at 1000 steps (20.0 s at 20 ms) and does not model the base_contact termination. The action space is Box(-inf, inf) upstream (manager_based_constraint_rl_env.py:342-344), so no finite envelope exists to probe: G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE reports CL2 instead of CL3 and no limit is invented. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for reset (Gymnasium interface provided by the upstream base outside the clone), G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and four G8.NO_UNIT (ticks, both seed inputs, action.values). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
